name: Run Elasticsearch
description: This action spins up an Elasticsearch instance that can be accessed and used in your subsequent steps.

stack-version.description: The version of the Elastic Stack you want to run

security-enabled.description: Enable or disable HTTPS, enabled by default

nodes.description: Number of nodes in the cluster

port.description: Port where you want to run Elasticsearch

elasticsearch_password.description: The password for the user elastic in your cluster

plugins.description: Plugins that you want to include

wait.description: Number of seconds to wait after launch

network-name.description: Name of the network to create with docker
